Severe pipeline alarms (`git-sync STALLED …`, `green-checkpoint STALLED …`) are
broadcast to every running agent. Before WI-1444 they were **fire-and-forget**:
when the watchdog detected recovery it cleared the escalation silently and the
broadcast was never superseded — an agent waking hours later read a stale
"STALLED" alarm as live truth and burned a turn investigating a dead condition.

## The lifecycle (WI-1444)

- **Alarm** — `broadcastSevereEvent({ …, conditionKey })` stamps
  `condition_key` on the envelope. The watchdogs use stable keys:
  `git-sync-stall:<install_slug>` and `green-stall:<install_slug>`.
- **Recovery** — the watchdog's recovery branch calls
  `broadcastSevereEventResolved({ conditionKey, summary })`, which broadcasts a
  `category: 'severe-event-resolved'` message carrying
  `resolves_condition: <key>` (and `condition_key`, so resolutions are
  queryable by key too).
- **Read** — `coord:inbox` annotates every returned entry whose
  `condition_key` has a **strictly-later** resolution with `resolved: true` +
  `resolved_at`. The scan runs over the full inbox read (pre-`limit`), so a
  windowed view still resolves correctly. A re-alarm *after* the latest
  resolution stays un-annotated — it is live again.

- **State view** — `coord:conditions` (EI-6138) folds the same stream into
  live per-condition state: open conditions first (claimable), then recently
  resolved. Use it to answer "is anything wrong right now?" without inbox
  archaeology. Sibling read-side hygiene: repeated categorized broadcasts in
  `coord:inbox` coalesce to one `repeat_count`-annotated row (EI-6144).

## What this means for you

- **An alarm with `resolved: true` needs NO action** — the condition already
  cleared; do not claim or investigate it.
- **An un-annotated severe-event alarm is (as far as the log knows) still
  open** — the claimable signal is unchanged.
- Adding a new watchdog/alarm? Pass a stable `conditionKey` on the alarm and
  broadcast the matching resolution on the recovery edge (guard it on the
  same transition edge as your `recovered` accounting so healthy passes stay
  silent). Fail-soft is built in — a broadcast failure never breaks the sweep.
